title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash ad4ec186ede7… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash ad4ec186ede7f4e22525b1f0d7657a96aa5397f5cb9ea2510ba55677437e8b64 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. This file was seen three times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file is associated with a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check for this hash in their environments and security tools.
